question: Which of the folowing honours did Manisha Ramadass receive in 2022?

options.text: Para Badminton Pair of the year by the World Badminton Federation (BWF)
Female player of the year by Government of India
Most Improved Player of the year by Sports Authority of India (SAI)
Best Female Para Badminton Player of the year by the World Badminton Federation (BWF)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Best Female Para Badminton Player of the year by the World Badminton Federation (BWF)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Ramadass:-**

 
 
• Manisha Ramadass is a Para Badminton player from India who has won several national and international tournaments.
 
• She received the Best Female Para Badminton Player of the year award by the World Badminton Federation (BWF) in 2022.
 
• This award recognizes her exceptional performance in the sport of Para Badminton.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Para Badminton:-**

 
 
• It is a sport designed for athletes with physical disabilities.
 
 
 
• **World Badminton Federation:-**
 
 
• (BWF) is the governing body for the sport of badminton globally.
 
 
 
• **Sports Authority of India:-**
 
 
• (SAI) is a government body that promotes and develops sports in India.
